# Fa widgets

> Sample JS widgets for the Fa agent: small apps written against the
> js_widget_runtime `jsr` API, executed inside Fa's sandboxed interpreter.
> Shell access, network calls and system services are default-denied; the
> widget's manifest declares what it uses and the app prompts the user.

## Catalog

- Machine-readable catalog (schemaVersion 1):
  https://github.com/IstiN/fa_widgets/releases/latest/download/catalog.json
- Per-widget artifacts: `<id>-<version>.zip` next to it in the same release,
  immutable version tags `<id>-v<version>` for pinning.
- Sources & contribution guide:
  https://github.com/IstiN/fa_widgets

Install via the Fa app: Plugins → Get widgets.

- [Widget gallery](https://fa1.dev/widgets/)
